title: A connected finite monodromy torsor trivializing a finite locally constant module sheaf
statement: Let $U$ be a nonempty connected scheme [def-weil-connected-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $\ell$ be prime, and let $G$ be a finite locally constant sheaf of $\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbf F_\ell)$-modules on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. There exist a finite group $Q$ in the universe of $U$, a connected finite etale $\operatorname{ULift}(Q)$-torsor $c:Y\to U$ [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois], and a finite-dimensional $\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbf F_\ell)$-module $A$ such that $c^*G$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is isomorphic to the constant module sheaf on $Y$ with value $A$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. No subgroup, prime-to-$\ell$ cover, or representation-to-sheaf functor is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0DV5 (3), Tag 0DV6, and proof of Tag 0A3R before the Sylow subgroup choice; also pione.tex Section 03SF (section-finite-etale-under-galois)

proof.text: Use finite_locally_constant_module_values_iff to choose finite local constant values for G; this supplies IsLisseModuleSheaf. The underlying-set characterization then gives a finite locally constant sheaf of sets.
Apply the connected finite-set monodromy torsor theorem to the underlying set sheaf and obtain Q and c with constant set pullback.
Apply module_pullback_isConstant_of_set_pullback on the connected total space c.P. Choose a module A and the constant module-sheaf isomorphism from this constancy witness.

IsFiniteSheaf.upperStar makes c^*G finite and IsFiniteSheaf.of_iso transports finiteness to the constant A sheaf. The existing moduleFinite_of_isFiniteSheaf_constantSheaf in KernelCokernel identifies A with a geometric stalk and supplies Module.Finite. Over the field ULift(ZMod ell) this is FiniteDimensional. Assemble Q, c, A, their instances, and the isomorphism.

proof_origin.note: U2: reduce via finite set monodromy and connected constant-module reflection; finite-dimensionality is proved with existing finite-sheaf/stalk lemmas. No target or statement change.

theorem Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.exists_finite_monodromy_trivializing_torsor
    {U : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace U] (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (G : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))))
    [IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf G] :
    ∃ (Q : Type u) (_ : Group Q) (_ : Finite Q)
      (c : Scheme.GaloisCover (ULift.{u + 1} Q) U) (_ : ConnectedSpace c.P)
      (A : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)))
      (_ : FiniteDimensional (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)) A),
      Nonempty ((c.π)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))].obj G ≅
        (constantSheaf c.P.smallEtaleTopology
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)))).obj A)
